description: This file is a shell script used for managing a git web interface web server, including starting, stopping, and configuring various web server backends (like lighttpd, apache, WEBrick, plackup, python). It handles external process invocation, configuration setup, and server lifecycle management.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolves the full path to the HTTP daemon executable based on the specified command.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the web server process based on configuration and server type.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the currently running web server process.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Polls the server until it is ready by attempting to connect to the specified port.

methods.name: webrick_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration and server script for WEBrick.

methods.name: apache2_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration for Apache HTTP server.

methods.name: plackup_conf
methods.description: Creates a standalone PSGI server script using plackup with embedded configuration.

methods.name: python_conf
methods.description: Creates standalone Python simple HTTP server script with CGI handling for gitweb.

methods.name: gitweb_conf
methods.description: Creates a configuration file for gitweb with Perl parameters.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Dispatches configuration generation based on selected server type.
